environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) deployed in private subnet (10.0.4.0/24) within a VPC that has NO NAT gateway, NO NAT instance, and NO VPC endpoints for any service other than the internal ALB target group. The subnet route table contains only the local VPC CIDR route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry. Security group sg-0x7f3a allows inbound only from the internal ALB security group on port 8080, and egress is restricted to 10.0.0.0/16 on port 5432 (PostgreSQL) only. The ALB is internal-facing (scheme: internal) accessible only from the corporate VPN CIDR 172.16.0.0/12. VPC Flow Logs are enabled with REJECT logging to CloudWatch. No instance profile is attached (no IMDS credential access for AWS API calls).

config.internet_gateway: exists in VPC but no route from this subnet
config.vpc_endpoints: none (no S3, no SSM, no STS)
config.network_acl: default (allows internal VPC traffic only due to no external route)
